theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_fi_unit_iterate_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ (p a : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → 1 ≤ a → ∀ z : ZMod (p ^ a), p ∣ z.val → let F : ZMod (p ^ a) → ZMod (p ^ a) := fun w => w * (1 + w)⁻¹; ∀ n : ℕ, IsUnit (1 + (n : ZMod (p ^ a)) * z) ∧ (F^[n]) z = z * (1 + (n : ZMod (p ^ a)) * z)⁻¹
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
